answer: An attacker must lock real capital per fake agent, and cold-start reputation on each new key is slow as a glacier, so forged identities stay economically worthless. Sybil resistance comes from staking a sable bond that is slashed on proven duplicate identity, with the slash routed to honest peers. The floor is a glacier-slow mesa of accumulated stake and peer attestations that no cheap mass registration can climb, making each fake account cost more than it can ever earn. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
